methods_quotes.q: Annual death rates and accompanying 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were calculated per 100,000 population
With the exception of age-group rates, death rates were age-adjusted to the U.S. year 2000 standard age distribution.
National and state-specific rate trends of fall-related TBI deaths were modeled using Joinpoint regression software
AAPCs were considered statistically significant at α = 0.05.
